spacr.qt.gil_priority.background_imports: Whether a live, recent hold asks the background imports to wait.
spacr.qt.gil_priority.hold_background_im:
Ask the optional background imports to wait while ``owner`` loads.

The window's warm imports (the data libraries and a module's pipeline
entry, torch included) compete with the GUI thread for the interpreter
lock; on Windows that starved an Overview's first browser open by
several seconds. A hold only postpones their start, never cancels it,
and lapses after :data:`HOLD_LIMIT_S` or when ``owner`` is deleted.

:param owner: the object loading; held weakly.
:param busy: optional ``busy(owner) -> bool``; the hold counts only while
    it answers True, so a view holds while it loads and not while it idles.
spacr.qt.gil_priority.release_background:
End ``owner``'s hold; the waiting imports start at their next check.

:param owner: the object that called :func:`hold_background_imports`.
spacr.settings.get_overview_default_sett:
The Overview module's settings, with their defaults filled in.

The image enhancement settings are Make Masks' own ``enhance_*``
settings, so a chain tuned there reads the same here.

:param settings: caller's settings, filled in with the defaults.
:returns: the completed settings dict.
spacr.settings.register_overview_default:
Register the Overview defaults, types and help.

The Overview tab lays its categories out itself, from
:data:`OVERVIEW_CATEGORIES` and the Measurements declarations, so the
shared category table stays as it was.

:param replace: overwrite an existing registration rather than declining.
:returns: True when this call did the registering.
